summaries.summary: This slide defines management elements, specifically focusing on efficiency and effectiveness as part of the definition of management. Efficiency is described as getting the most output from the least amount of inputs, concerned with means. Effectiveness is defined as completing activities to attain organizational goals, concerned with ends.
key_facts: Efficiency: getting the most output from the least amount of inputs
Efficiency: 'doing things right', concerned with means
Effectiveness: completing activities so organizational goals are attained
Effectiveness: 'doing the right things', concerned with ends
visible_text: Efficiency - getting the most output from the least amount of inputs
Effectiveness - completing activities so that organizational goals are attained
